body:
I could reproduce the perceived regression in 4.4.dev1 and 4.4.rc2 with the steps to reproduce.

Here's a MRP for testing: [new-game-project21.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19016494/new-game-project21.zip)

But it doesn't seem to be a bug, it's just a consequence of a change in the default configuration for NavigationRegion3D in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/95013.

The Geometry > Parsed Geometry Type used to default to Mesh Instances only, and it now defaults to handle both Mesh Instances and Static Colliders. Your reproduction project only has a Static Collider, so that's why in 4.3 the bake is instantaneous - it's empty as nothing gets parsed. In 4.4.dev1 it now parses the StaticBody3D's collision shape and since it's pretty big, it's slow.

You can change the property in your project to restore previous behavior.
